CustomField.description: Developer name of the EmailTemplate used for this record's emails, by LyytiDeletionAlertService on CampaignMember, Contact and Lead deletes. The template must contain {_Datatable_} where the table of deleted members is injected; its Subject is the email subject.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Enter the DeveloperName of the EmailTemplate (e.g. LyytiDeletionAlert). It must include {_Datatable_} where the table of deleted members should appear.
CustomField.label: Email Template
